title: First Run
summary: Standard starter: pick up a sealed parcel at the board and walk it across town to Ketch's garage. Pays insulting-but-honest money. Teaches your bike who you are.

objectives.label: Pick up the parcel at the job board
Test the bike — touch the dune overlook beacon
Deliver the parcel to Ketch's garage

offer.text: New courier rates apply, which is to say the pay is a rounding error with ambition. But the parcel's real, the route's flat, and Ketch tips in gossip.

accept.text: Parcel's on the hook behind the board. Wax seal, Guild stamp, very official.
Ketch on the radio, kid. Take her past the overlook first — I want to see you climb a dune before I let you carry anything breakable. Which is everything. Everything is breakable.
Copy. Any crate, any storm, any extremely gentle hill.

complete.text: There she is. Parcel intact, bike intact, rider mostly intact — a Driftline miracle.
Now listen. Tamsin's holding something at the exchange with your name on it. Not your name, actually. No name. That's the interesting part.
